arChildNodes.szComment:
A young adult Rathma is on his knees before Lilith, shoulders and head low. He is upset, but mostly in control of his emotions.

The area around them is littered with large demon corpses.
The vitriol in Rathma's words take Lilith aback.
Rathma stands to look Lilith right in the eye.
Something in Lilith snaps. She rushes over to Rathma, grabbing him firmly by the chin and forcing him to hold her glare.

Lilith leaves with a flourish. 

Rathma's head and shoulders fall in defeat.
